description: This Java source file defines an immutable logging adapter class 'ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter' that extends 'ThreadSafeDittoLoggingAdapter'. It manages MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context) entries for logging, allowing correlation IDs and MDC entries to be added, removed, or discarded, and delegates logging notifications to an underlying 'DiagnosticLoggingAdapter'.

classes.name: ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter
classes.description: An immutable, thread-safe implementation of a logging adapter that manages MDC entries and delegates logging to an underlying DiagnosticLoggingAdapter.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter with a provided DiagnosticLoggingAdapter supplier.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Internal method to create a new ImmutableDittoLoggingAdapter, optionally extending MDC entries.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Associates a correlation ID with the logging context, either from a CharSequence or from headers.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the correlation ID from the MDC.

methods.name: withMdcEntry
methods.description: Adds or removes a single MDC entry based on key and value.

methods.name: withMdcEntries
methods.description: Adds multiple MDC entries at once.

methods.name: removeMdcEntry
methods.description: Removes an MDC entry by key.

methods.name: isErrorEnabled
methods.description: Checks if error level logging is enabled.

methods.name: notifyError
methods.description: Logs an error message, optionally with an exception.
